source.quote: PSEG reported dividends paid of $0.67 per share in the quarter and $1.34 per share year-to-date
non-GAAP Operating Earnings of $425M ($0.86/share). Non-GAAP Operating Earnings rose from $384 million, or $0.77 per share in the prior year
PSEG reaffirmed a $24-$28B, mostly regulated, 2026-2030 capital plan
Regulated rate base increased ~7% at YE 2025 over YE 2024
